faqItems.q: How does consolidated invoicing work for our company?
faqItems.a: At the end of each calendar month, you receive a single consolidated invoice detailing all trips and rentals completed by your employees, itemized by cost center, employee ID, and project code. Ready for export into your ERP systems (SAP, Sage, QuickBooks).

faqItems.q: What are the prerequisites to activate an enterprise B2B account?
faqItems.a: Corporate entity onboarding takes minutes with your company registration/VAT number, recent business extract, and corporate officer ID. Verification SLA is under 15 minutes during business hours.

faqItems.q: Can vehicles be driven across national borders?
faqItems.a: Yes, our entire enterprise fleet includes full cross-border authorization and comprehensive insurance coverage internationally with no hidden surcharges.

faqItems.q: How does the 60-minute guaranteed replacement SLA operate?
faqItems.a: In case of technical issues or emergencies, our corporate dispatch team delivers a replacement vehicle of equal or superior class on-site or at the nearest hub in under 60 minutes.

faqItems.q: Can we adjust our fleet volume or cancel without penalties?
faqItems.a: Absolutely. Unlike traditional 36-48 month leases, our B2B plans have zero rigid commitments. Scale your fleet volume up or down based on business seasonality without early termination penalties.
